asked.item: Where to add VAT number themselves
VAT shown on invoices going forward

verdict.reason: The VAT/tax ID section states how customers add it themselves via the billing portal Tax ID field and that it appears on future invoices.

steps.text: Go to Settings > Billing and click "View Billing Portal".
Open your billing information, update your company name and address, and insert your VAT or tax ID directly in the Tax ID field.
Your VAT or tax ID then appears on future invoices.
